Partial replacement of Mo with W in M4 produced the MW1 alloy, which contains traces (less than 1% by volume) of a secondary phase, which is located at or near grain boundaries of the BCC matrix phase and has dark contrast on backscatter images (Figure 2g).

According to the EDS analysis, the composition of the matrix grains is close to the average alloy composition, while the secondary phase is rich in Ti (Table 4). EBSD phase analysis reveals BCC crystal structure of the Ti-rich secondary phase.
